testimonials.quote: “This husband-and-wife duo was the perfect addition to our Americana-themed grand opening. She was exactly what we needed, her voice and presence brought everything together, and together they created a warm, lively vibe that made the event truly special. Highly recommend!”
testimonials.author: Mia V.

testimonials.quote: “The music is absolutely beautiful. Gary captivates the crowd from the minute he starts playing and keeps them to the very end. We have had Gary at our a venue a few times and will be sure to have him back again!”
testimonials.author: Michele

testimonials.quote: “Gary is an amazing musician, reliable and easy to work with. Fans love Keepin' It Dirty with these guys and will show up to support! I book them multiple times a month to keep our patio packed during patio season... perfect for any venue or event!”
testimonials.author: Amy E.

testimonials.quote: “Gary wowed our crowd with fantastic guitar playing. We have him back at least once a year. Thank you Gary for sharing your talent with us.”
testimonials.author: Eric

testimonials.quote: “Certainly one can say Emily Barnes is outstanding in her field!!”
testimonials.author: Groove in the Grove

testimonials.quote: “Saw you at Rickey Farm, you are so amazing!! You brought tears to my eyes. Can't wait to hear you again.”
testimonials.author: A listener

testimonials.quote: “Their poignant lyrics, captivating voices, and iridescent stage presence made a lasting impression. We look forward to their return...”
testimonials.author: Sandy Streid

testimonials.quote: “...We discussed what we were looking for, (funky jams) and they delivered. It was the perfect band for my husband’s 50th. They are personable, professional, and very talented musicians.”
testimonials.author: Jill B.

testimonials.quote: “Their combination of upright bass and guitar brought an effortless sophistication and warmth to the evening. Their musicianship was truly outstanding. Elegant and refined. They have a remarkable ability to enhance the atmosphere without overpowering it...”
testimonials.author: Annette M.

testimonials.quote: “[He] was a pleasure to work with and have perform at our anniversary. We asked for background jazz and he delivered. [He] is everything you want in a professional musician. All of our guests were complementing our musical duo, and may have inspired one of our family members to pick up their guitar again. We highly recommend [him].”
testimonials.author: Brett H.

testimonials.quote: “I hired [him] to play at my wife's 40th birthday celebration. Very professional, punctual and responsive and a very talented musician.”
testimonials.author: Brian B.

testimonials.quote: “[He] and the musicians he works with were awesome for our corporate event. We plan to hire them again for future events.”
testimonials.author: Debra W.

testimonials.quote: “I hired [him] for a duo performance at our Jazz Night, and he and his partner did an amazing job! They played saxophone and guitar, and the residents couldn’t stop talking about how much they enjoyed the evening and the music. I will definitely be hiring them again!”
testimonials.author: Sara G.

testimonials.quote: “We hired [him] to play at our company’s holiday event. He and his partner made it very easy to work with them. They set up and played the whole time. Feedback from our guests was very positive. Everyone loved having the live music and it really added that special touch.”
testimonials.author: Diane H.

testimonials.quote: “[He] naturally read the vibe and flow of the crowd, adjusting intensity and volume of the performance accordingly. He checked in during the event to ensure he was delivering what was asked for, but there was no direction needed.”
testimonials.author: Lindy R.

testimonials.quote: “...From beginning to end. Pulled together bandmates for my husband’s 80th outdoor birthday bash. Guests were impressed with the repertoire. More than the usual cover band: jazzy sophistication.”
testimonials.author: Noreen S.

testimonials.quote: “You and your high energy wedding band absolutely killed it on our special day! … We are still getting great feedback from our guests about what an amazing job the band did and how much fun you guys are to just watch play, let alone dance the night away with!”
testimonials.author: Joan M. K.

testimonials.quote: “Everyone was on the dance floor enjoying themselves for the entire evening. Not only are they superb musicians, but also amazing entertainers with a show-stopping style. … Best of all, they knew how to read a crowd.”
testimonials.author: Kelly

testimonials.quote: “Little Moses Jones & their production team, Spot On Sound Productions, were spot on with the design, entertainment & communication for my wedding. Whenever we come to Denver, we try to catch one of their performances.”
testimonials.author: Paul

testimonials.quote: “The band was great, Moses! Thanks again for being part of the event.”
testimonials.author: Zack S.

testimonials.quote: “A month before our wedding, my husband and I stumbled upon Little Moses Jones at an event, playing ALL our favorite 90s and 2000s hip-hop and R&B with live instruments. We couldn't believe how many people our parents' age (60s+) were loving them too. Moses went above and beyond to make it happen last-minute. They didn't just play music. They created an experience we'll never forget.”
testimonials.author: Jessica D.

testimonials.quote: “I cannot recommend Little Moses Jones enough! From the moment they started playing, they set the perfect tone for our wedding and kept everyone dancing all night long. Their energy and stage presence truly brought the vibes to life. The band’s blend of hip-hop, R&B, soul, and wedding classics was exactly what we were looking for. They transitioned seamlessly between genres, keeping the dance floor packed and the atmosphere electric. We received countless compliments from our guests about how much fun they were having. Little Moses Jones not only played incredible music but also engaged with the crowd, creating a memorable experience for everyone. If you’re looking for a band that knows how to create an unforgettable atmosphere and keep the party going, look no further than Little Moses Jones! They truly made our wedding a night to remember!”
testimonials.author: Spencer C.

testimonials.quote: “We hired Moses and his band for our wedding last month and they were INCREDIBLE! They were professional, kind, and so so much fun with their performance. Their range of genres is also amazing. We had a duo play jazz during the cocktail hour, a trio play rock songs that we requested for them to learn during the ceremony, and the full band play retro throwbacks and 90's hip hop during the reception. The lead singers were amazing and worked the crowd really well. Everyone was up and partying and the dance floor didn't die once during the night. Our guests gushed about them after the event and still bring up how good they were whenever we see people. If you are looking for a non-cookie cutter, quality band that won't just play radio songs all night, these are your people!”
testimonials.author: Callie W.

testimonials.quote: “You know the band is great when no one leaves the dance floor ALL NIGHT! Truly, our wedding guests commented all night long how fun the Moses Jones Band was, asked where they were from (which we proudly told them, Denver!) and the energy and quality of their music was absolutely incredible. Not only was the music great, the production was very professional-sound and lighting-and the band learned and played our first dance song beautifully. They kept all ages on the dance floor with their set list, and our friends are still saying how much fun they had.”
testimonials.author: Megan S.

testimonials.quote: “Moses Jones Band made our party! They are so easy to work with and you can tell they are enjoying what they do. They had us all dancing the night away. We are still hearing from our friends what a great party it was.”
testimonials.author: Carolyn F.

testimonials.quote: “As they say, better late than never. Mine and my wife's wedding was back in September of 2016, the Moses Jones band played at our wedding reception, and they were awesome! Our families still mention to us how great the band was, and how much fun they had during the dance party whenever we see them. The Moses Jones Band is really talented. They even transported all their gear up a mountain to perform at our venue... All in all, we would highly recommend the Moses Jones Band to anyone.”
testimonials.author: Matthew P.

testimonials.quote: “This review is over 3 years late! Moses Jones played our wedding on 7/4/15 in Lyons, CO and they were amazing! You know it’s a great band when all of the guests are on the dance floor. Awesome to work with. Professional. SO fun. Best night ever.”
testimonials.author: Brady P.

testimonials.quote: “I had Little Moses Jones at our wedding last week and I have to say they are the best band I ever had the pleasure to work with. Little Moses Jones went above & beyond to cater to all of our needs and desires. The performed everything from dance music to jazz for the cocktail hour. I would recommend this band a million times if I could. Thank You Little Moses Jones Bride- Lori Beckman”
testimonials.author: Lori B.

testimonials.quote: “I am not exaggerating when I say that Little Moses Jones made our wedding. We had been fans from hearing them play around Denver, and knew they were the ones for our wedding. But we underestimated how much energy they’d bring and how incredibly FUN our reception would be. I still have people telling me how amazing they were. Their jazz group also played at the ceremony and cocktail out, and were fantastic. A huge thanks to the whole group, but especially to Little Moses for his help planning and Tarla for being so awesome. Summer H Bride”
testimonials.author: Summer H.

testimonials.quote: “The Moses Jones Band travelled to our mountain in Meeker CO to play for our son's wedding to his lovely Jessica. My son and Jessica loved the band, their friends loved the band. We all danced our hearts out. Our old friends loved the band. Everyone came up to us later or wrote us how wonderful the band was. If I had more kids I would hire them back again. You can't go wrong with the Moses Jones Band!”
testimonials.author: Bill L.

testimonials.quote: “The Moses Jones Band has provided the music at two weddings for our family. The first wedding was in Breckenridge at the top of the mountain. The second was last month at the Hyatt in Denver. Both parties were as perfect as could be because of the music, entertainment, and spirit of this band. From the first contact, thru the events, they were extremely professional, they communicated often and effectively, and most importantly, they listened to what WE wanted and then DELIVERED. Their style and musical skills had our guests on the dance floor from the first song until the very end. I would highly recommend this band for an event where you want FUN and great music. Thank you to Moses and all the band.”
testimonials.author: Debra M.

testimonials.quote: “Moses Jones Band played our wedding at the Boulder Theater in September. In that venue, we made the music a high priority and we could not be happier in our selection. The band was amazing, and our guests raved about how much fun they were. The dance floor was packed all night. Excellent wedding entertainment, they know how to please the crowd with classic and modern songs. Amazing!”
testimonials.author: Carrie T.

testimonials.quote: “Music was so important to us, and we were starting to get a little frustrated looking for bands last year. We heard of Moses Jones and went to see them at a local bar and knew from song #1 they were the band for us! They are full of so much energy and are like having a full on concert at your event. We always told people that we weren't having a "wedding band", we were having a band at our wedding. Moses is the best to work with. We had to change way too many things about the schedule of the songs and how things were going to fall into place. He couldn't have been nicer and kept making changes until everything was perfect. Our guests danced their tails off and had the best time. Everything we wanted and then some.”
testimonials.author: Jamie N.

testimonials.quote: ““Best Wedding Band Ever” is what I'm still hearing from everyone who attended my wedding. This group is amazing...you can tell they're having fun at what they're doing and they were so willing to work with us to do whatever we wanted... They made our wedding.”
testimonials.author: Elizabeth K.

testimonials.quote: “Please let me know when you guys will be back at Q's, I saw you there a few months ago, and you were unreal! I love your sound! I would love to see you again! Fantastic horns, you guys have the full package! Put me on your email list! Carmen”
testimonials.author: Carmen P.

testimonials.quote: “I love the energy that this band displays in their live shows. They create a highly danceable environment and interact with the audience to create a truly memorable experience. Their vocalists and horns are top notch and have choreographed dances that instigate the crowd to move and groove to the funky beats of their smoking' rhythm section.”
testimonials.author: A I.

testimonials.quote: “We hired Meghan for a Country Western dinner party and had a wonderful time! We hired her with Todd on the steel guitar and both of them were phenomenal together! She has a wonderful voice, wonderful chemistry with the rest of the band and was very personable with the guests at the party! There was dancing and hootin and hollerin' and I would not hesitate to book them for another event! Thank you Meghan!”
testimonials.author: Alex K.

testimonials.quote: “I perchance saw Meaghan and her Cavemen, They were all amazing musicians. They opened up with the “House of The Rising Sun” I had to stay and listen until the end of the night.. great show, flawless performance.”
testimonials.author: Jim J.

testimonials.quote: “I love working with this band! On time, professional, friendly. I would recommend them to anyone without hesitation.”
testimonials.author: Katiepie

testimonials.quote: “Meghan and her Cavemen were great! They brought a dynamic country sound to our festival lineup with a mix of Meghan's original songs and country classics. Their rendition of My Church was the highlight of the show! Also a great group to work with. I highly recommend them.”
testimonials.author: Tom Q.

testimonials.quote: “René was amazing! René was a consummate professional, oh and his musical skills were spot on! Highly recommended!”
testimonials.author: Paul K.

testimonials.quote: “Showed up early, played great music. Very personable and nice guy.”
testimonials.author: Al G.

testimonials.quote: “Rene was a pleasure to work with. Prior to our event he was very easy to communicate with, very responsive. He showed up on time, and his performance was wonderful. His music is great, and was the perfect fit for our event. I would highly recommend Rene and will definitely be booking him for future events.”
testimonials.author: Katie K.

testimonials.quote: “Roma Ransom was perfect for dinner service in our restaurant Sacred Grounds Cafe and Wine bar... We would recommend them to everybody and we booked them as many nights as they want.”
testimonials.author: Natasha S.

testimonials.quote: “I was lucky enough to have [her] perform at my 50th birthday party. I couldn't image it would have be as special without her! [She] is the BEST at what she does.”
testimonials.author: Lori W.

testimonials.quote: “To say that our guests adored [her] would be an understatement. After an experience with entertainers at our upscale resort venue that we had to let go, [she] swooped in and saved the day with her eclectic mix of music from every era and style! Along with her drummer, she played music that set a great tone and was a perfect fit for our guests. I highly recommend [her] music.”
testimonials.author: Samuel R.

testimonials.quote: “I’m an event planner, and I work with tons of musicians. [She] is the best! She always goes above and beyond for my clients, and can learn their special songs even when she’s booked last minute. Not only is [she] extremely talented, but she is also professional and fun to work with. Do yourself a favor, and hire her! You’ll be glad you did!”
testimonials.author: Stephanie F.

testimonials.quote: “Hired this musician for our office happy hour and it was a great call good music, easy vibe, and it made the whole event more fun.”
testimonials.author: Isabella A.

testimonials.quote: “I couldn't have asked for a better musician for my event. From the very beginning, he communicated promptly, was easy to work with, and immediately understood the atmosphere I wanted to create for the event. His music was the perfect fit, creating an ambiance that my guests absolutely loved. So many people commented on how much they enjoyed the music, and it truly added to the overall success of the evening. If you're looking for a talented, professional musician who is reliable, responsive, and knows how to set the perfect tone for an event, I highly recommend him. I would gladly have him perform again.”
testimonials.author: Skip Z.

testimonials.quote: “Would love to have him back!”
testimonials.author: Cleo B.

testimonials.quote: “[He] is fantastic to work with! He’s incredibly talented, professional, and always brings great energy to every event. Our residents truly enjoy his performances every time. He’s a great musician and consistently creates a fun, engaging atmosphere. Highly recommend!”

testimonials.quote: “[He] provided music for our conference opening reception attended by over 300 people. He did a great job. Everyone enjoyed his music and he tailored his performance to exactly what we asked for.”
testimonials.author: Clay C.

testimonials.quote: “[He] was fantastic to work with: very communicative, proactive, and an excellent musician. I would highly recommend!”
testimonials.author: Jordan S.

testimonials.quote: “Great music! [He] was a pleasure to work with! We thoroughly enjoyed the music!”
testimonials.author: Kathy B.

testimonials.quote: “[He] came to play in our home for a party and did an amazing job! He is a talented musician and was extremely easy and responsive to work with. He was able to play exactly the type of music we were looking for. Thanks for taking our party up a notch!”
testimonials.author: Conner S.

testimonials.quote: “Our guests couldn’t stop talking about how amazing he was, and we loved how he read the crowd and kept everyone engaged. He went above and beyond to make our day special, even learning a few of our favorite songs just for us.”
testimonials.author: Savannah H.

testimonials.quote: “[He] recently played for my wedding ceremony, and I couldn’t be happier or more grateful. He is extremely talented and so sweet, my guests and I loved him!! He played ‘Bless the Telephone’ by Labi Siffre while I walked down the aisle and it was a dream. I would hire him 1000 times over.”

testimonials.quote: “Awesome Jazz Solo, very professional!!!”
testimonials.author: Megan L.

testimonials.quote: “[He] played for a corporate event for us and it was perfect! Created such a nice ambience for a casual summer party out on the patio. Super easy, efficient and talented. We will definitely use him again! Highly recommend.”
testimonials.author: Madeline G.

testimonials.quote: “[He] is incredibly professional and prompt. Our patrons enjoyed the music and had a great time.”
testimonials.author: Dominic H.

testimonials.quote: “If you're looking for someone to create a great atmosphere for your event, look no further than [him]! He provided the perfect background music, setting an energetic and fun tone to the evening. He was also incredibly professional, on time, and responsive to all my questions. Top-notch musician... Can't wait to hire him again!”
testimonials.author: Rachel G.

testimonials.quote: “He was so kind, made Easter fun! We were so grateful to have him! He is extremely talented”
testimonials.author: Rikaya V.

testimonials.quote: “Great all around! Perfect for our grand opening !”
testimonials.author: Joshua C.

testimonials.quote: “[He] was fantastic, he struck the right note (pardon the pun) with our guests by not only playing beautifully, but also by playing quietly in the background so as not to disturb the conversation of our guests. Everyone loved him and would 100% hire him again. He is a tru pro!”
testimonials.author: Mara S.

testimonials.quote: “At our family outing, we all thoroughly enjoyed [his] playing and his musical selections. He is very professional and musically talented.”
testimonials.author: Yvonne M.

testimonials.quote: “[He] was perfect for our Spanish themed event. Great music and extremely nice.”
testimonials.author: James R.

testimonials.quote: “[He] played at our wedding at the Clayton Hotel in Cherry Creek on Sept 17th. Having such a skilled flamenco guitarist brought our ceremony and cocktail hour to a whole new level. He also put together some fantastic music for the ceremony itself. Overall, [he] is the consummate professional I wholeheartedly recommend to anyone looking to set a romantic vibe. You won’t be disappointed!”
testimonials.author: Colleen S.
